title: Response-Relevant Information Is Not Sufficient for Neural Training-State Equivalence
abstract: arXiv:2611.23245v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Response-relevant information is not sufficient evidence that two neural networks are in the same training state. We define training-state equivalence operationally: two checkpoints are equivalent, relative to an intervention family and horizon, if they respond alike when training is perturbed and continues. On fresh runs of a one-layer transformer learning modular addition, response to a weight-decay pulse is highly reproducible relative to between-checkpoint differences (rho_state = 0.934 at 500 steps), establishing the target as measurable. Fifteen descriptors of weight spectra, representation geometry and optimiser geometry carry within-run response-relevant information beyond weight norm and loss on a development dataset, predicting held-out response deviation across seed blocks. translated_title: 响应相关信息不足以判定神经网络的训练状态等价性
translated_abstract: 响应相关信息并不足以作为两个神经网络处于相同训练状态的证据。我们对训练状态等价性给出了操作性定义：相对于某个干预族和时间范围，如果两个检查点在训练受到扰动并继续进行时表现出相似的响应，则认为它们是等价的。在单层Transformer学习模加法任务的全新运行实验中，相对于检查点之间的差异，对权重衰减脉冲的响应表现出高度可复现性（500步时 rho_state = 0.934），这确立了该研究目标是可以测量的。来自权重谱、表示几何和优化器几何的十五个描述子，在开发数据集上携带了超出权重范数和损失的运行内响应相关信息，并能跨随机种子块预测留出的响应偏差。然而，这些描述子通过未来响应匹配检查点时表面上16.1%的优势，无法与一个保留每个描述子……的条件安慰剂区分开来（原摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 尽管权重谱、表示几何和优化器几何等描述子携带响应相关信息并能预测训练扰动后的响应偏差，但它们仍不足以作为判定两个神经网络检查点训练状态等价的充分依据。
en_tdlr: Descriptors of weight spectra, representation geometry, and optimizer geometry carry response-relevant information, yet are insufficient to establish training-state equivalence between neural checkpoints as measured by responses to training perturbations.
